Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: While retrieving results for “The Tiger: An Old Hunter’s Tale,” the WebSurfer surfaced an auto-generated DuckDuckGo “Search Assist” snippet incorrectly stating the country of origin as the United States. This is false (the film is South Korean per authoritative sources like Wikipedia/IMDb) and, if relied upon, would lead to the wrong yes/no conclusion about whether both works are from the same country.
